summary: 人类何时抵达南美最南端的巴塔哥尼亚，取决于如何解释冰川退却、迁徙速度与考古遗存。文章比较早晚两说，再根据多个可靠遗址推测，人类约在一万一千年前抵达。
logic: 提出最南端定居时间之谜
比较早期与晚期迁徙说
区分遗存年代与人类活动证据
综合遗址给出时间推测

paragraphs.brief: 美洲南部极端地区的人类住区一直令古代人着迷。
sentences: The human settlement of the southern extremity of the Americas has always fascinated prehistorians.
美洲南部极端地区的人类住区一直令古代人着迷。
Viewed from a global perspective, this was the last major continental land mass to be reached by human beings.
从全球角度来看，这是人类能够到达的最后一个主要大陆陆地群。

The earliest occupation of Patagonia carries obvious implications for understanding when the North and South American continents were peopled, because it gives a baseline that all calculations regarding the rate of dispersion of humans throughout both continents must take into account.
最早占领巴塔哥尼亚对理解北美洲和南美洲大陆是人的时候有着明显的影响，因为它提供了一个基准，即关于人类分散在两个大陆的速率的所有计算都必须考虑到。

paragraphs.brief: 多年来，北美洲和南美洲的人类住区一直被认为是从远北地区开始，逐步向南前往巴塔哥尼亚。
sentences: For many years the human settlement of North and South America has been conceived of as beginning in the far north and travelling progressively southwards to Patagonia.
多年来，北美洲和南美洲的人类住区一直被认为是从远北地区开始，逐步向南前往巴塔哥尼亚。
However, fundamental disagreements developed concerning the length of time involved.
然而，在所涉时间长短问题上出现了根本的分歧。
Some scholars accepted a human presence in the Americas as early as 20,000 years ago, while others proposed that it could date no earlier than 8,000 years ago, and the debate is still with us today.
一些学者认同早在两万年前美洲就有人类活动，另一些则认为最早不过八千年前。这场争论至今仍在延续。

paragraphs.brief: 美国的"晚"定居 (大约8000年前) 的想法暗示了迅速的迁徙过程。
sentences: The idea of a relatively ‘late’ settlement of the Americas (around 8,000 years ago) implies that a rapid process of migration took place.
美国的"晚"定居 (大约8000年前) 的想法暗示了迅速的迁徙过程。
Herein lies a second debate, which revolves around the question of how migration is to be understood.
这里还有第二次辩论，围绕着如何理解移徙问题。
The ‘late’ model demands a hypothetical migration conceived of as a single, continually advancing wave of settlement.
“晚期”模式要求一种假设的移徙，被设想为单一的、不断推进的定居浪潮。

This has always been difficult to take seriously, and many scholars now support the idea of an ‘early’ model that sees the migration as a less ordered migration, and this is surely the most realistic scenario as migrants slowly adapted to the diverse natural habitats they would have met while travelling through the continent.
这一直难以认真对待，许多学者现在支持“早期”模式的想法，认为移徙是一种顺序不那么有序的移徙，这肯定是最现实的情况，因为移徙者在穿越非洲大陆时，会慢慢适应不同的自然生境。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，主张人类更早定居于此的人必须正视一个问题：对于年代早于约 1.4 万年前的考古遗址，目前还缺乏确凿无疑的证据。
sentences: Those who argue for an earlier settlement, however, must contend with the lack of unequivocal evidence for archaeological sites older than around 14,000 years.
然而，主张人类更早定居于此的人必须正视一个问题：对于年代早于约 1.4 万年前的考古遗址，目前还缺乏确凿无疑的证据。
Nevertheless, evidence for human occupation of the centre of South America is now securely dated to around 12,500 years ago at the Monte Verde site, which casts doubt on the ‘late’ model.
不过，蒙特韦尔德遗址的可靠测年已将人类在南美洲中部活动的证据推至约 1.25 万年前，这让“较晚定居”模型受到质疑。
The lack of archaeological evidence further south for this time period may be explained by the obstacle to humans on foot posed by the huge glacial streams that were present at that time.
这一时期在南方更远的地方缺乏考古证据，其原因可能是当时巨大的冰川流给步行的人造成障碍。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，其他一些最初假定有更早的人类占领证据的地点最近受到新的审查。
sentences: We can speculate then that the retreat of the Patagonian glaciers around 14,000 years ago allowed the initial human intrusion into a pristine environment, which was similar to that of early post-glacial Europe.
我们可以推测，在大约14000年前巴塔哥尼亚冰川的退缩使得人类最初侵入了一个原始的环境，这类似于早期的冰川后欧洲。

Human settlement of the vast horizontal expanse of treeless high country must have been tenuous at best, and the evidence for this occupation remains relatively scant, most of it coming from rock shelters in Argentina and Chile.
无树高地国家广阔的横向住区最多只能说是薄弱的，这种占领的证据仍然相对稀少，大部分来自阿根廷和智利的岩石掩体。
There is, however, reliable evidence from these sites to confirm the presence of humans by around 11,000 years ago in different habitats, and some hints of an even older occupation.
不过，这些遗址的可靠证据表明，约 1.1 万年前，人类已经生活在多种不同的环境中；还有一些线索暗示最初的定居时间可能更早。
However, some other sites where evidence for even earlier human occupation was initially posited have recently come under fresh scrutiny.
然而，其他一些最初假定有更早的人类占领证据的地点最近受到新的审查。

This is because anthropologists have come to recognise that bones or other evidence may be deposited in caves by natural agency—in other words, by other forces such as floods or predators—and not necessarily by humans.
这是因为人类学家已经认识到，骨骼或其他证据可能由自然体——换言之，由洪水或掠食者等其他力量——而不一定由人类存放在洞穴中。

paragraphs.brief: 我们现在将更详细地讨论巴塔哥尼亚各地发现的考古证据。
sentences: We shall turn now to a more detailed discussion of the archaeological evidence found in various parts of Patagonia.
我们现在将更详细地讨论巴塔哥尼亚各地发现的考古证据。
At the site located beside Chinchihuapi Creek, excavations have produced convincing evidence of human occupation, including hut foundations and wooden artefacts.
在Chinchihuapi溪附近的遗址，挖掘活动提供了令人信服的证据，证明人占领，包括茅屋地基和木制人工制品。

They were buried in layers of peat, which has the property of preserving wood remarkably well, and as a result, radiocarbon dating tests have shown these artefacts to date from around 12,500 years ago.
他们被埋在泥炭堆中，其特性是保护木材，结果是，放射性碳代号测试显示这些人工制品大约12500年前。
One of the most famous Patagonian sites is a cave known as Los Toldos.
最著名的巴塔戈尼亚遗址之一是一个叫做Los lettos的洞穴。

However, the evidence from this site has recently been called into question, because dispersed flecks of carbon used in the test process were taken unsystematically from many different places at the site.
然而，该场址的证据最近受到质疑，因为试验过程中使用的散落的碳斑块是从该场址许多不同地点被系统化地采集的。
As a result, the association of this material with the artefacts is not at all clear.
因此，这种材料与手工艺品的联系并不清楚。

About 150 kilometres to the south is the site called El Ceibo, where a similar collection of artefacts to that found at Los Toldos has been discovered from the lowest levels of the dig, but as yet no radiocarbon dates are available, and this sort of analysis of the existing evidence is required before the site’s value can be confirmed.
南边约150公里处是名为El Ceibo的场址，在该处发现与Los Lototos相似的手工制品，但挖掘底层发现，但至今没有放射性碳日期，在确认该场址的价值之前，需要对现有证据进行这种分析。

paragraphs.brief: 艾罗约埃奥遗址位于高原很近。
sentences: The Arroyo Eeo site is located very close to the high plateau.
艾罗约埃奥遗址位于高原很近。
The artefacts from the earliest occupations were found at the same depth and have the same origins as those from Los Toldos, and have been securely dated to around 9,000 years ago.
最早的人类活动遗物与洛斯托尔多斯出土的同类遗物埋藏深度相同，来源也相同。可靠的测年结果表明，它们约有 9,000 年历史。
Another site that is mentioned in the debate is at Las Buitreras, where a number of stone flakes associated with bone remains of various animals have been discovered.
辩论中提到的另一个地点是拉斯比特雷拉斯，在那里发现了一些与各种动物的骨骸有关的石片。

However, anthropologists now believe that presumed cut marks on the bones are somewhat dubious, and despite detailed testing there is no way of securely relating any of these remains to human occupation.
然而，人类学家现在认为，假想的骨头上的伤痕有些可疑，尽管进行了详细的试验，但没有任何办法将这些遗迹与人类的占领安全地联系起来。
Finally, some 50 kilometres to the south is the site at Cueva Fell, which was the first Patagonian site to be systematically studied by modern archaeological methods.
最后，南面约50公里处是Cueva Fell的遗址，这是第一个用现代考古方法系统研究的帕塔戈尼亚遗址。

However, it is now recognised that the utility of this site must be restricted to its direct vicinity, given changes to the nearby area caused by flooding, and findings cannot be freely extrapolated further afield.
然而，现在人们认识到，鉴于洪水对附近地区造成的变化，这一地点的用途必须限于其直接附近，因此无法自由地推断出更远的地方。

paragraphs.brief: 总的来说，根据几处可靠遗址提供的证据，人类很可能在约 1.1 万年前到达巴塔哥尼亚。
sentences: In conclusion, based on the evidence from a number of reliable sites, it seems probable that human populations reached Patagonia around 11,000 years ago.
总的来说，根据几处可靠遗址提供的证据，人类很可能在约 1.1 万年前到达巴塔哥尼亚。

items.en: In the first paragraph, what is the writer’s main point about migration to Patagonia?
items.zh: 在第一段，作者对移民到巴塔哥尼亚有什么看法？
correct: It impacts on research into the wider region.
它影响到对更广泛区域的研究。

items.en: In the second paragraph, what is the writer’s purpose?
items.zh: 第二段，作者的目的是什么？

items.en: The writer refers to the ‘late’ model in order to
items.zh: 作者提到“迟交”模式，以便
correct: compare it with another theory of migration.
把它和另一个移民理论相比较

items.en: What is the writer’s main point about the ‘early’ model?
items.zh: 作者对“早期”模式的要点是什么？
correct: It is more consistent with the physical conditions of the land.
它更符合土地的物质条件。

items.en: What does the writer suggest about the Monte Verde site?
items.zh: 作者对蒙特贝尔德遗址有何看法？
correct: It provides supporting evidence for relatively early settlement.
它为较早解决提供了佐证。

items.en: The conditions encountered by the first migrants to Patagonia were unique.
items.zh: 第一批移民来到巴塔哥尼亚时所遭遇的情况是独特的。
items.why: 文中明确说与欧洲冰后期环境相似，并非“独特/唯一"。与题干矛盾 = NO。

items.en: In the high country the first migrants hunted wild animals for food.
items.zh: 在高地国家，第一批移民以野生动物为食。
items.why: 高地定居的证据很少，多来自岩棚。文中没有说明最早抵达高地的移民是否以猎捕野生动物为食。

items.en: Archaeologists have failed to draw conclusions from the evidence found at rock shelters in Argentina and Chile.
items.zh: 考古学家未能从阿根廷和智利的岩石掩体中发现的证据中得出结论。
items.why: 文中说这些遗址可靠地确认了人类存在，与“未能得出结论相反 = NO.

items.en: Archaeological evidence can be moved from place to place in a variety of ways.
items.zh: 考古证据可以不同方式从一个地方移到另一个地方。
items.why: 了明确说明证据可由洪水/掠食者等多种方式带入洞穴题干与原文一致 = YES。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: The archaeological evidence from Patagonia Building remains and other evidence have been found in ________ at the Chinchihuapi Creek site, and because of this it has been possible to date them to around 12,500 years ago.
items.zh: 在钦奇瓦皮溪遗址，发现建筑遗迹及其他证据时，它们均处于 ________，因此得以测定其年代约为距今一万二千五百年。
items.why: 泥炭层保存性好 = 文物状况良好，据此得以测年。

items.en: However, the ________ of the samples taken from Los Toldos means that this site is of doubtful value.
items.zh: 然而，洛斯托尔多斯遗址样本的 ________，使得该遗址的证据价值存疑。
items.why: 取样不系统/随机 = random collection 使证据价值存疑。

items.en: The remains found at the Arroyo Eeo site show ________ and date from around 9,000 years ago.
items.zh: 阿罗约遗址出土的遗存表现出 ________，其年代约为距今九千年。
items.why: “同一深度+同一来源”=相似属性。

items.en: Unfortunately, no ________ can be made between the samples taken from Las Buitreras and human presence.
items.zh: 遗憾的是，无法在拉斯布伊特雷拉斯的样本与人类活动之间建立 ________。
items.why: 无法建立可靠联系”= reliable connection。

items.en: The findings of the work carried out at Cueva Fell cannot provide useful information beyond the ________.
items.zh: 对费尔洞穴的研究成果，只能提供关于 ________ 范围之内的有用信息。
items.why: 结论仅限直接周边/即时环境 = immediate surroundings。

groups.label: 选词填空
groups.instructionsZh: 阅读带空格的中译，回想正确词项及其字母。

pairs: 题干和原文都指采样缺少系统性，这使检测结果受到质疑。
has recently been called into question
题干把考古证据的价值描述为存疑，原文用“受到质疑”表达同一点。
第 5 段 · 第 5 句
第 6 段 · 第 3 句
points: 高地定居的证据很少，多来自岩棚。文中没有说明最早抵达高地的移民是否以猎捕野生动物为食。
取样不系统/随机 = random collection 使证据价值存疑。
clauses: Some scholars accepted a human presence in the Americas as early as 20,000 years ago, while others proposed …, and the debate is still with us today.
“that it could date no earlier than 8,000 years ago”补足 proposed 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 proposed 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
“which revolves around the question of how migration is to be understood”修饰前面的 debate。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 debate，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: Anthropologists continue to investigate human migration to Patagonia at the southern tip of South America
人类学家继续调查人口向南美南端巴塔哥尼亚的迁徙
vocabulary: 对其他研究的启示；影响
